reason: A dsh Web GUI appearance plugin that adds a configurable WebGL silk background and applies glass-style theme token overrides.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh Web GUI 添加可配置的 WebGL 丝绸动态背景，并通过主题令牌覆盖提供玻璃化界面外观。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable WebGL silk animation background and glass-style theme token overrides to the dsh Web GUI.

capabilities: Renders a WebGL animated background in the web interface
Overrides supported theme tokens to apply a glassmorphism-style appearance
Provides local controls for display mode, speed, intensity, and colors
Persists user display settings in browser localStorage
